title: Response fingerprint atelier: per-route p50/p95/p99 latency with streaming vs non-streaming decomposition
creator: Diego Morales
description: Build a single explorer (the 'Response Fingerprint Atelier') that surfaces per-model/per-route latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and decomposes them by I/O mode (streaming vs non-streaming). This ticket covers: trace hook integration to propagate request shape metadata, metrics/log pipeline transforms to emit io_mode and servepath tags, and a dashboard implementation with drilldowns into traces for tail-latency debugging. Goal: reduce MTTI for latency regressions caused by streaming/non-streaming divergence and surface regressions by model family and route.
comments: 2026-02-18 - Diego Morales: Initial ticket created. Problem observed: streaming requests p95 is diverging from non-streaming for specific llama-family models on /v1/chat and /v1/generate. Root cause unknown; hypothesis: KV cache warm/cold effects + different batching paths. Proposed work: add io_mode tag through tracing hooks and aggregate percentiles by servepath + io_mode.

2026-02-22 - Priya Singh: Scoped the work. Three deliverables: 1) lightweight trace hook to annotate incoming requests with 'io_mode' and 'request_shape' (tokens_in, top_k_flag), 2) metrics pipeline transforms (clickhouse/bigquery) to materialize p50/p95/p99 by model, route, dataset, and io_mode, 3) dashboard with drilldown to traces and example runbook entries. Estimate 8 pts. Blocking: final sampling policy for traces from ENG-412358.

2026-02-26 - Backend: Implemented initial trace hook prototype on serving runtime branch feature/trace-io-mode. Hook emits request tags and logs a span at request start/finish. PR opened: platform#4829. Unit tests added for span tags. Note: added a conservative sampling decision to avoid additional egress cost.

2026-03-02 - Observability: Updated metrics pipeline SQL to backfill io_mode for last 30d from log-based inference (heuristic: presence of websocket_uuid -> streaming). Backfill results: streaming accounts for 18% of requests but 34% of p99 latency weight on llama-large family routes. Added new materialized view response_fingerprint_v1.

2026-03-05 - Design review (Aisha Patel): Dashboard mock approved with the following changes: 1) show cohort selector (conversation_length buckets), 2) add toggle to normalize by token_count, 3) include heatmap for route x model family p99. Action: Priya to update wireframes and hand off to frontend.

2026-03-09 - Frontend: Implemented three panels: percentile sparklines (p50/p95/p99), streaming gap waterfall (difference p95_stream - p95_nonstream), and cohort table linking to trace explorer. PR opened: web-console#991. Need to wire up trace links to the new span-id format (trace-reqid) produced by feature/trace-io-mode.

2026-03-12 - SRE feedback (Marcus Lee): Recommend alert heuristics: create synthetic SLO windows for streaming vs non-streaming on critical routes with a p99 guardrail. Also suggested including cold-cache marker in spans to attribute warmup spikes. Added as follow-up under sub-issue ENG-600112.

2026-03-14 - Priya Singh: Canary plan drafted. Steps: merge trace hook behind feature flag, deploy to canary region us-west-2 for low-traffic customers, validate span propagation and materialized view accuracy (compare counts and percentiles against logs). If stable for 72h, roll out to all regions. Next: finalize PR comments and schedule rollout with Infrastructure team.
Open follow-ups: ENG-600112 (cold-cache tagging and warmup detection), ENG-600113 (alerting and synthetic test suites), ENG-600114 (embedding the dashboard into customer-facing console with RBAC).
